attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (etcd was not pre-installed on any node), loaded application keys, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member by stopping etcd and deleting its data directory, removed the dead member via etcdctl while quorum (node1+node2) stayed up, added a fresh member for node3, and started a new etcd process there with --initial-cluster-state existing. The new member synced via raft and served all original keys. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and post-restart cluster/data health each time, finishing with all 3 members healthy and all keys intact.
